<!-- Generated by internal/tools/docgen from the cobra command tree. DO NOT EDIT: run `make docs-reference`. -->

Runs a query (a Bronto WHERE expression) against one or more datasets.
Without a time flag or a saved search's range it searches the last 15 minutes.
Pass '-' as the query to read it from stdin.

:::tip[Learn more]
The Bronto docs explain the platform concept behind this command: [docs.bronto.io/query-syntax/search-syntax](https://docs.bronto.io/query-syntax/search-syntax)
:::

```sh
bronto search [query] [flags]
```

#### Flags

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--dataset` | `-d` | stringArray |  | dataset name or UUID to search (repeatable) |
| `--eq` |  | field=value |  | keep events where field equals value (repeatable, ANDed) |
| `--exact` |  | bool |  | use filter-flag field names exactly as typed, without $-prefix or case matching |
| `--expand` | `-x` | bool |  | print every field of every event, one field per line (table output only) |
| `--explain-only` |  | bool |  | return only the query plan and cost estimate |
| `--from` |  | string |  | absolute start (RFC3339) |
| `--from-expr` |  | string |  | dataset selector expression, e.g. "log\_id = '&lt;uuid&gt;'" |
| `--ge` |  | field=value |  | keep events where field is greater than or equal to value |
| `--group-by` | `-g` | stringArray |  | group-by key (repeatable) |
| `--gt` |  | field=value |  | keep events where field is greater than value |
| `--histogram` |  | bool |  | print a time histogram of matching events instead of the events themselves |
| `--le` |  | field=value |  | keep events where field is less than or equal to value |
| `--limit` | `-n` | int | `100` | maximum events to return (1-10000) |
| `--local` |  | string |  | run the query offline against a local NDJSON or text file ('-' for stdin) |
| `--lt` |  | field=value |  | keep events where field is less than value |
| `--match` |  | field=value |  | keep events where field matches the regex value |
| `--ne` |  | field=value |  | keep events where field does not equal value |
| `--nmatch` |  | field=value |  | keep events where field does not match the regex value |
| `--oldest-first` |  | bool |  | return oldest events first |
| `--open` |  | bool |  | open this query in the web UI instead of running it |
| `--order-by` |  | string |  | SQL-style order, e.g. 'duration\_ms DESC' |
| `--patterns` |  | bool |  | group matching events into message templates with counts (Drain-style) |
| `--saved` |  | string |  | run a saved search by name or id (explicit query/dataset/time flags override its stored values) |
| `--select` |  | stringArray |  | column or aggregate to select (repeatable) |
| `--show-query` |  | bool |  | print the compiled WHERE expression (the query ANDed with the filter flags) and exit |
| `--since` |  | string |  | relative lookback: 30s, 15m, 1h, 2d, 1w, 1h30m |
| `--slices` |  | int |  | timeseries buckets for aggregate queries (also sets --histogram resolution) |
| `--to` |  | string |  | absolute end (RFC3339), requires --from |
| `--url` |  | bool |  | print a web-UI link for this query instead of running it |

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

#### Examples

```sh
bronto search "status >= 500" --since 1h
bronto search "level = 'error'" -d <dataset-uuid> --limit 50
bronto search -d <dataset> --eq model=claude-fable-5 --gt duration_ms=1000
bronto search --select "count()" -g host --since 15m
bronto search --explain-only --since 1d
```
